payloads.players: docs/scrum/data/<S>/players.json -> cols/rows (id, n, team, pos, grp, age, gp, min, q, <metric>, p_<metric>)

method.seasons: calendar years 2006 to now (player statistics); 160+ minutes a year to qualify
method.yoy: Pearson r of per-80 rates in consecutive years, z-scored within year and group
method.split_half: odd v even appearances within a year
method.m50: mean half-sample minutes x (1 - r) / r
method.predictive: r with next year's Scrum value per 80

minimum.note: minutes in the window (the last two years on the Board, a calendar year for a season row)

groups.basis: per 80 minutes, shrunk toward the group with 240 minutes of prior

metrics.explanation: Our player value: points added to the final margin per 80 minutes above a replacement-level player in the same position group, from what each carry, break, tackle, turnover and penalty is worth (a model fitted on 2004-2018 tests), plus goal kicking above an average kicker.
Tackles made per 80 minutes.
Tackle success: tackles made out of tackles attempted.
Carries (runs with the ball) per 80 minutes.
Lineout throws won: the share of a hooker's throws his side wins (our source credits the thrower), shrunk toward 86% with 30 throws of weight.
Rucks won per 80 minutes.
Involvements per 80 minutes: carries, tackles and rucks won together, the work rate.
Penalties conceded per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
Points scored per 80 minutes: tries, conversions, penalties and drop goals.
Tries per 80 minutes.
Try assists (the last pass or kick before a try) per 80 minutes.
Metres gained with the ball in hand per 80 minutes.
Metres per carry: how far a carry goes on average.
Clean breaks (carries through the defensive line) per 80 minutes.
Defenders beaten per 80 minutes.
Offloads (passes out of a tackle) per 80 minutes.
Passes per 80 minutes.
Missed tackles per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
Turnovers conceded per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
Kicks from hand per 80 minutes.
Goal-kicking success: conversions and penalties kicked out of attempts.
Mauls won per 80 minutes.
Knock-ons per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
Yellow and red cards per 80 minutes, a red counting as two (fewer is better).
Goal-kicking points per 80 minutes: conversions, penalty goals and drop goals.

view.why: Props and hookers: the tackle count and its success, carries and rucks, and the hooker's lineout throws (the scrum itself is a team stat).

value.name: Scrum value
value.about: Our player value: points added per 80 minutes above a replacement-level player in the same position, from a regression of the final margin on the process statistics.

rating.name: Our team rating
rating.about: Points better than an average test side on a neutral ground, with home advantage, travel and rest taken out.
